title: Observability: wolfCrypt error codes masked before returning to userspace
description: When ops->sess_init() fails at src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:627-631, the wolfCrypt error code is passed through directly without logging. Callers see -EINVAL (or whatever the provider returned) but the kernel ring buffer contains no record of which algorithm failed, which provider was selected, or what the raw wolfCrypt error was (e.g., -173=BAD_FUNC_ARG vs -125=MEMORY_E vs FIPS_DEGRADED). Same pattern throughout write/update and read/finalize paths. A support engineer cannot distinguish 'invalid key length' from 'FIPS degraded' from 'OOM' from dmesg alone.
